t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Gnomes appear in set pairs. Orange, Green Red and Blue will take you to a bright forest.The Pink, Brown, Yellow and Purple gnomes will take you to a dark forest. The height and gesture of the gnomes doesnt matter, only the colours. The number of mushrooms will vary between the two forests. You must track which forest is better and try to get there by picking the right colour gnome. The above is the same in mutiplier rounds.

vb_textbox.text: The important factor is the colour of the gnome. You will always be choosing between a gnome that takes you to a dark forest and a gnome that takes you to a brighter forest. Green, Orange, Red and Blue will lead to the brighter forest. Pink, Brown, Yellow and Purple lead to the darker forest. At any time, one forest will have better odds to give lots of mushrooms. But this will switch periodically. You must track which forest is giving better rewards and try to visit that one. Use the 1x multiplier rounds to test the forests and see what the rewards are. Use the 5x multipliers to gain lots of points!The odds of the forests may switch after a few rounds, or many, so be willing to test and switch often if needed. However, sometimes the better forest may give a low reward, there is an element of chance.
